gnosh doctor

  Check that a turn could run here. Reads the config for this folder and
  prints one line per check. Exits 1 when a turn could not run. Starts no
  model.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh doctor [flags]

Flags
  --hosts
      Also try each declared host: log in to it with ssh and run nothing
      there. Without this, doctor reaches no other machine. (Not built yet.)
  --cwd <dir>
      Work in this folder instead of the current one.
  -D, --data-dir <dir>
      Keep sessions and data in this folder instead of the project's own.
      Commands that read them look there too.
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
